cohort: The participants were 93 women with sickle cell disease (SCD) receiving care across five tertiary centers.
finding: The study found no statistical difference in adverse maternal and fetal events between women with TRV ≥ 2.5 m/s and those with TRV < 2.5 m/s, therefore not supporting TRV of 2.5 m/s or more as an independent predictor of adverse obstetric outcomes among women with SCD.
